commit_message: refactor(input): support multi-line terminal command help

replacements.old: help: Union[str, Callable[["terminal_context"], str | None], None] = None,
replacements.new: help: Union[str, list[str], Callable[["terminal_context"], str | list[str] | None], None] = None,

replacements.old:
value = command.help(self) if callable(command.help) else command.help
            if value is None or value == "":
                continue
            items.append(f"{self.fnPrefix}{name}    {value}")

"help": input_module.terminal_command(
                lambda ctx, _args: ctx.help(),
                "show help",
            ),
            "info": input_module.terminal_command(
                info,
                lambda _ctx: "<name> = show profile info",
            ),
replacements.new:
"help": input_module.terminal_command(
                lambda ctx, _args: ctx.help(),
                "show help",
            ),
            "info": input_module.terminal_command(
                info,
                lambda _ctx: [
                    "<name>    show profile info",
                    "<name> full    show full profile info",
                ],
            ),

[
                (":help show help", ""),
                (":info <name>    show profile info", ""),
                (":info <name> full    show full profile info", ""),
